exposure: Duration of exclusive breastfeeding (EBF) (4-5 months vs. 6 months or older)
cohort: 108 healthy term infants (birth weight > 2500 g) from Bogota, Colombia, all exclusively breastfed for ≥4 months
finding: Anaemia and ID were common at 6 months but were not affected by EBF for 4 to 5 versus 6 months, suggesting 6 months EBF is safe in this population.
